benchmarks.name: State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust

assumptions: Each contribution remains cash at zero return until the first completed exchange session strictly after its ledger date.
Raw closes determine initial fractional shares; adjusted-close growth factors model distributions reinvested and split adjustments.
Commissions, bid-ask spread, slippage and taxes are zero, so this is an idealized passive comparator.
Gas-token contributions are excluded because the project reference capital is the 170 USD of trading capital.
The script excludes an in-progress session and refuses future, missing, malformed or stale prices.
Yahoo's public chart feed can revise historical adjustments; retain the report's retrieval time and source URLs with any recorded comparison.
